hooks.prompt: A `git commit` is about to run in this repo. Perform a review of the STAGED changes by following the project's `change-review` skill (.claude/skills/change-review/SKILL.md): inspect `git diff --staged` (and `git status` for new files the change depends on), run the build/lint/tests the change touches, and weigh unhappy paths. BLOCK the commit (deny) if you find any `bug` or `issue`, listing each as `**[type]** summary` followed by detail so the author can fix it before committing. Allow the commit when there are no `bug`/`issue` findings; `nit` and `question` do not block. $ARGUMENTS
